name: storeops-api
description: StoreOps Retail Store Operations Management REST API (capstone reference codebase)

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

note: This project deliberately uses zero runtime dependencies (no Express/Jest/supertest/ESLint). See DESIGN_BRIEF.md Section D for the architectural decision and rationale. A custom minimal router replaces Express, node:test replaces Jest+supertest, and a small custom AST-free lint script replaces ESLint for the specific StoreOps architecture rules.
